nodes.summary: At equilibrium the de novo fraction is `s_het`.
nodes.title: At equilibrium the de novo fraction is `s_het`

nodes.summary: The fraction of LoF alleles in the next generation that are new mutations, from frequency `x`: `U / ((1 - s) x + U)`.
nodes.title: Fraction of de novo loss-of-function alleles

nodes.summary: `U / s` is an equilibrium of the multiplicative diploid model (an algebraic identity for `s ≠ 0`, `U ≠ 1`; a frequency in `[0, 1]` when `0 ≤ U ≤ s`).
nodes.title: `U / s` is an equilibrium

nodes.summary: One generation: selection, then mutation of wild-type alleles at rate `U`.
nodes.title: One diploid generation of selection and mutation

nodes.summary: The kernel entries are probabilities when the sampling probability is in `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Transition kernel entries are probabilities

nodes.summary: The transition probability from `i` LoF copies among `N` to `j` copies among `N'`: binomial sampling of `N'` copies with success probability `(1 - s)(i / N) + U`.
nodes.title: Binomial transition kernel for loss-of-function counts

nodes.summary: The law of the LoF count in generation `t` for population sizes `N t` (any demography), started from `μ₀`.
nodes.title: Law of the loss-of-function count under any demography

nodes.summary: Equilibria lie at or below `U / s` when homozygotes are at least multiplicatively unfit (`2s - s² ≤ t`, which includes recessive lethality `t = 1`): every fixed point `q ∈ [0, 1)` of the diploid map satisfies `q ≤ U / s`.
nodes.title: Equilibria lie at or below `U / s`

nodes.summary: `U / s` is the unique fixed point.
nodes.title: Unique fixed point $U/s$ of the linear recursion

nodes.summary: Closed-form orbit: `x_t = U / s + (1 - s)^t (x_0 - U / s)`.
nodes.title: Closed-form orbit of the linear mutation–selection recursion

nodes.summary: One generation of the linear model: `x ↦ (1 - s) x + U`.
nodes.title: Linear mutation–selection recursion

nodes.summary: `1 - w̄ = 2U - U²` at the multiplicative equilibrium (`U ≠ 1`, so `U / s` is a fixed point).
nodes.title: Haldane–Muller load

nodes.summary: At the multiplicative equilibrium the mean fitness is `(1 - U)²`, independent of `s`. Requires `U ≠ 1`, so that `U / s` is genuinely a fixed point (`diploidStep_mult_fixed`): for `U = 1` the point `U / s` is not an equilibrium.
nodes.title: Mean fitness at the multiplicative mutation–selection equilibrium

nodes.summary: With multiplicative fitness, `w̄ = (1 - s q)²` for every `q`.
nodes.title: Mean fitness under multiplicative fitness

nodes.summary: Mean fitness is positive for `0 ≤ q < 1` and `s, t ≤ 1` (nonnegative fitnesses).
nodes.title: Positivity of mean fitness for allele frequencies below one

nodes.summary: Mean fitness under Hardy–Weinberg with LoF frequency `q` and fitnesses `1, 1 - s, 1 - t`: `1 - 2 q (1 - q) s - q² t`.
nodes.title: Mean fitness under Hardy–Weinberg proportions

nodes.summary: For every sequence of positive population sizes, `E[X_t]` follows the deterministic linear recursion (derived from the binomial mean). The identity holds for all real `s, U`; `law` is a probability law when `0 ≤ U ≤ s ≤ 1` and `μ₀` is one.
nodes.title: Demography-free mean

nodes.summary: For any sizes `N`, `N' > 0` and any distribution `μ` of total mass one, the mean frequency after one generation is `(1 - s) m + U`.
nodes.title: Demography-free mean, one step

nodes.summary: The mean LoF frequency `∑ μ_i (i / N)` of a distribution `μ` on `Fin (N + 1)`.
nodes.title: Mean loss-of-function frequency of a distribution

nodes.summary: One generation of the chain acting on distributions.
nodes.title: One generation of the chain on distributions

nodes.summary: LoF frequency after selection: `q (1 - s (1 - q) - t q) / w̄`.
nodes.title: Loss-of-function frequency after selection

nodes.summary: The binomial mean: `∑_j kernel(i, j) (j / N') = (1 - s)(i / N) + U` for `N' > 0`.
nodes.title: Binomial mean of the transition kernel

nodes.summary: The kernel rows have total mass one (for every real sampling probability).
nodes.title: Rows of the transition kernel have total mass one

nodes.summary: Pushing a distribution forward preserves total mass.
nodes.title: Pushing a distribution forward preserves total mass

nodes.summary: For `0 < s < 2` every orbit converges to `U / s`.
nodes.title: Global attraction

nodes.summary: The expected LoF frequency converges to `U / s` under any demography.
nodes.title: Expected loss-of-function frequency converges to $U/s$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
